label: drift
title: Monorepo: a change in one service flags only that service
notes: One repo, 2 services with the same script name. The ledger page (glob services/ledger/**) quotes LEDGER_ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT, which the change renamed: flags. The payments page (exact path, its own service glob, and a whole-repo anchor) must stay quiet: repo-wide anchors never alert alone.

pages.title: Payments rollback (platform monorepo)
pages.storage:
Roll Payments back from the root of the platform repo.

Set PAYMENTS_ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT for slow releases.

pages.title: Ledger rollback (platform monorepo)
pages.storage:
Roll Ledger back from the root of the platform repo.

Set LEDGER_ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT for slow releases.

change.title: ledger: take the rollback timeout in seconds
change.author: Sam Rivera
change.hunks:
diff --git a/services/ledger/scripts/rollback.sh b/services/ledger/scripts/rollback.sh
index ee0b61b..ca884cd 100644
--- a/services/ledger/scripts/rollback.sh
+++ b/services/ledger/scripts/rollback.sh
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 # Roll ledger back to the previous Helm revision.
 set -euo pipefail
-TIMEOUT="${LEDGER_ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT:-300}"
+TIMEOUT="${LEDGER_ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT_SECS:-300}"
 helm rollback ledger --wait --timeout "${TIMEOUT}s"
